SPORTS DEVELOPMENT ACT 1997

SPORTS DEVELOPMENT (AMENDMENT OF SECOND SCHEDULE) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 37 of the

Sports Development Act 1997 [Act 576], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Sports Development (Amendment of

Second Schedule) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 10 March 2023.

Amendment of Second Schedule

2. The Sports Development Act 1997 is amended by substituting for the

Second Schedule the following schedule:

"SECOND SCHEDULE

[Section 19]

CONSTITUTION OR RULES OF SPORTS BODIES ACTING AS THE GOVERNING

OR REPRESENTATIVE BODY OF ITS SPORT AT NATIONAL, STATE AND

DISTRICT LEVEL

The sports body shall provide in its constitution or rules the following matters:

1. Objects or functions of the sports body are—

(a) to govern or becomes representative for that sport;

(b) to promote and develop its sports;

(c) to maintain good relations with its governing body;

(d) to ensure its constitution or rules are abided by all its members;

(e) to control and exercise jurisdiction over all activities in relation to

its sports;

(f) to ensure its sports activities are conducted in safe sports

environment, and with integrity including to comply with

anti-doping rules which are internationally recognized; and

(g) to take remedial actions for matters involving personal and

environment safety including sexual harassment and abuse.

2. Its activities are conducted without discrimination as to sex, race, colour,

religion, social origin, language, political inclination or any other opinion held by

its members.

3. The selection procedures for sportsperson, officials, coaches and any other

person to represent its sport are open and fair.

4. Membership of sports body is recorded and kept in order.

5. Its fully audited accounts with reports on all activities, and the use

and disbursement of all funds for its preceding financial year to be laid

and approved in its annual general meeting and subsequently to be submitted

to the Commissioner together with such other reports as the Commissioner

may require.".

Made 6 March 2023

[KBS.S.DS.1-05-70 Jld. 13 (3); PN(PU2)587/Jld. 4]

YEOH TSEOW SUAN

Minister of Youth and Sports
